Decision was hard to make even with the help from solar quotes. Decided from adds and hopefully made a correct decision. Remove and dispose of old system.

Salesperson was good at his job.  He had me pay a deposit before I received the quote.  Dumb thing for me to do I know.  Anyway, the quote I received was for 7.5KW when we spoke of 10KW so straight up I am getting less than I would have been paying for.  I called the salesperson who was quick to respond when he realised I wanted to pull out of the deal but when he could not convince me to stay and I wanted my deposit back, he then said he was "on another call" and could he call me back. . . . 2 calls, 2 texts and 3 days later and he still has not followed me up.  I have made a complaint via email.  I will wait and see if I get any response.  Lucky I only paid $300 deposit. I had 3 quotes via this site and they all came in over about 25k for 13kw system with 10kwh battery . I contacted Sunboost separately as their ad had appeared when I did the initial google search.Sunboost quoted for virtually identical system (just different make of panels) and was significantly cheaper than all the other quotes. IMO getting solar is a lottery and the quality of the final system depends largely on the quality of the installers. In my case at least the installers were superb, so I guess I was lucky. I’ve been up on the roof and every part of the installation is high quality. The wiring and conduit is all correctly rated and the whole system has functioned flawlessly for the past year. I couldn’t be happier with it. My only gripe with Sunboost was the lack of a pre-installation visit.  They do everything over the phone. As a direct result of this, there were a few surprises for the installers (and particularly the excellent electrician) which resulted in a few minor delays which could have been avoided if someone had come out to scope the job earlier. In the end Sunboist shipped some extra parts out from their office by Uber (which they paid for), so no great drama really, but I spent quite a while with the electrician before he could even start work as it turned out solar batteries can’t just be shoved anywhere. Post installation I received several calls from Sunboost asking how my system was going. I got the impression that they were VERY keen to get good reviews and were trying very hard to improve customer service to achieve that. I have a Sungrow 10Kw hybrid, 3 phase Inverter and 9.6Kwh battery. The electrician helped me setup the Sungrow app on my phone and it has also worked flawlessly for this past year. I used to pay well  over $1000/quarter for electricity and now all annual bill is less than zero.
Very efficient with the whole process and installation time was ok. They did however take my ladder and had to return it.

They were not that co-opporative and in the end reluctantly said they would install it for an extra $1500! A bit disappointing.  Will be getting our battery elsewhere.

I considered 5 quotes before making a decision. 3 of these were organized by Solar Quotes. The variation in system capacity and associated cost were enormous. While most people quoting appeared quite knowledgeable from a technical aspect, very few focused on the financial aspect namely the projected payback period. Eventually I took a leap of faith (in spite of several bad reviews) and went for the cheapest system that (all going well) will give me a projected 2 year payback. Be prepared to negotiate with this company and make sure you have everything in writing. Having said that, once we were through finalising the quote everything has gone very smoothly. At this time I would happily recommend Sunboost Solar.

But I just say, since the start of the process it has been nothing but positive for me. They first gave me an amazing price. I then changed my inverter to the fronius inverter and again they gave an amazing price. I paid a small deposit of $100 upon confirming and my install was due for 5 months later (due to construction not being finished on my end). Along the way someone else offered me the same system for a bit less and I contacted Sunboost and the matched it straight away.I ended up out of pocket less than $3300 for a 6.6kw system (fronius 5kw inverter and 18 x Trina HoneyM panels)Constant contact was made along the way with callbacks that day if they were busy. The install took place on the day it was booked for. I paid the whole bill when the installers arrived and they got straight to work. It was a straight forward install that took roughly 3.5-4hrs. The installers were local installers that yes are subcontractors (that may not speak English as a first language) but they were pleasant, efficient and effective. The lead installer seemed to know what he was doing and they took care of everything they handled. So far the post installation support has also been sufficient with Sunboost taking care of basically everything for me.I know that some people will have negative experiences as you will anywhere. I know that it may happen a little more frequently with cheaper companies. But I call a spade a spade and I have had a faultless service from Sunboost for an unreal price. I have attached photos of the install.
Everything went smoothly front the first call to installation , we are happy to start saving

I have done a lot (and I mean A LOT) of research into solar panels, inverters etc. for my home in Tasmania.  I contacted 3 local companies one highly recommended to me, as well as contacting Sunboost.  All companies came and had a look at my property and Sunboost did it over a satellite photo.  Two of the Tasmanian companies supplied me with the best options available for my situation - microinverters, (I live in the bush and am surrounded by trees) and prices were between $11,516.00 and $13,750.00 and the other was a bit lower but they never returned my call after the inspection.  Sunboost could offer me the same system as the more expensive quotes for $6,700.00 so, I decided to go with them.  I paid a $300.00 deposit (this is fully refundable and I know this because I did change my mind once before and got the full refund - no questions asked!). Sunboost then sent a brilliant CEC Accredited Electrician/Engineer around to check out the house and talk to us about best places for the panels to be placed, Jonathon was very thorough, helpful and offered great suggestions. Jonathon also installed a hot water timer for us (at no extra cost) whilst he was here and we started to notice savings from this straight away - recommend everyone to get one of these and to change to tariff 93 with Aurora, although they wouldn't like you to know that! I then signed up to their finance company Brighte (very easy and quick and was approved that night) and at just $126.00 a fortnight over 2 years it is already paying for itself - they do charge a $3.00 monthly account keeping fee which works out at $156.00 over the two years.  Mark from Sunboost is the utmost professional, he returns all calls and emails straight away (I had a lot of questions!) in a friendly and extremely helpful manner.  I could not recommend Sunboost more, Mark is outstanding and if you can ask for him I would highly recommend him!I have 20 x Trina HoneyM Half Cut Cells with microinverters and a Fronius Primo 6kW inverter.I had a couple of issues with the Fronius app and Mark was able to sort this out for me as well.I HIGHLY RECOMMEND SUNBOOST, MARK AND JONATHON AND THEIR TEAMS!!!

I do not have any comments to make at this time thanks.

The most significant thing to note was that the Quote (Contract) terms changed from the original sent to more specific wording, e.g. that callouts for repairs or inspection was to be at our expense.Please also note that the pricing on the Quote (Contract) is not firm, and that the subcontractor installer is able to add his own costs.Be very wary and read the small print.

I do not recommend Sunboost to anyone. For others like myself that have little to no experience with solar, I would strongly advise you to avoid Sunboost and visit an in store solar company instead.My family and I may have it all connected, however, we have so many questions and issues that are not able to be answered through Sunboost.The lack of information is ridiculous.The STC Financial Initiative document does not explain how to access it, what to do in order to access it or who to contact in order to begin accessing it. The document we were provided with is pointless.Upon having our smart meter installed we were left with no information package at all. We have no idea how it works or what any of the codes mean.Once everything was installed, we attempted to create and access our account which supposedly tells you about the energy you use, the energy you created and how much is being transferred back to the grid. We find ourselves having to repeat our questions and get the receiver to re-explain what they said multiple times because we are unable to understand what was said due to the receiver having strong accents. Talking to the call centre is almost impossible.
Sunboost supplied middle quality hardware at less then half the total of some other quotesFailed to see what spending an extra 5k achieved at this pointTime will tell……..!

I wish I had never heard of this company, have been rescheduled for installation now that many times i'm done with them, who rings up last minute to cancel oh wait Sunboost do.I'm talking hours before once again it was supposed to be installed if their product is anything like the customer service lies god help us, anyone else reading this please keep searching for another solar company this mob will only give you heartbreak.
